title: Scheduled Jobs

templates.title: Job Templates
templates.description: Quickly create scheduled jobs from templates

insight.name: Daily AI Investment Insights
insight.description: Automatically analyze positions daily and generate investment insights
insight.instructions: Analyze my portfolio risks, unusual movements, and opportunities every day. Focus on position changes, abnormal volatility, risk exposure, and actionable suggestions.

reportWeekly.name: Weekly Investment Review
reportWeekly.description: Automatically generate a weekly investment report every Monday
reportWeekly.instructions: Review last week's portfolio performance, explain return drivers, major risks, key position changes, and market events to watch next week.

reportMonthly.name: Monthly Asset Report
reportMonthly.description: Automatically generate a monthly investment report on the 1st
reportMonthly.instructions: Summarize last month's asset performance, attribution, drawdown risk, trading behavior, and allocation changes, then list focus areas for next month.

agent.name: Custom Agent Task
agent.description: Describe a task in natural language, AI Agent executes it on schedule
agent.instructions: Describe what you want AI to do periodically, e.g., check if Tesla drops below $200 every day and notify me.

form.createDescription: Run AI analysis on a schedule, with manual runs available anytime.
form.name: Job Name
form.instructionsPlaceholder: Describe what this job should focus on, such as risks, report priorities, or output style.
form.instructionsHint: This will be saved as generation preferences for insights or reports; the selected task type still defines what can run.
form.agentPromptPlaceholder:
Describe in natural language what you want AI to do periodically.

Examples:
- Check if Tesla drops below $200 every day and notify me
- Analyze which stocks in my portfolio have upcoming earnings
- Review latest news for my tech holdings and summarize key points
form.agentPromptHint: The AI Agent reads this instruction on each run, uses available tools (stock prices, news search, portfolio analysis, etc.) to complete the task, and sends results via notification.
